description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a frame‑chain structural block containing sequential frame layers, symbolic operators, strict indentation, and controlled blank‑line architecture exactly as provided.

input.prompt:
Output exactly:
FRAME::FRAMECHAIN

[ROOT]
  STATE::STABLE
  VECTOR->HOLD

  [FRAME-1]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::F1
    TIER::PRIMARY

  [FRAME-2]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::F2
    TIER::SECONDARY

[STRUCTURE]
  MATRIX:
    FRAMEBLOCK-1:
      - X1
      - Y2
    FRAMEBLOCK-2:
      - Z3
      - W4

{CHECKSUM-FRAMECHAIN}
  Q9-P8-O7-N6

<END-FRAMECHAIN>

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving indentation, nested structures, blank lines, operators, symbols, list formatting, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines beyond those given, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire framechain block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
